en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by Muhammed bin Hasan bin Ahmad bin Waleed, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Hussain bin Hasan bin Aban, from Hussain bin Sa’eed, from Hammad bin Isa, from Ibrahim bin Umar al-Yamani, from the one he mentioned, from Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him,
with regards to the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: «And their prayer was, at the House, not but warbling and applause.» [8:35] He said: Whistling and handclapping.
